svg.text: What people actually ask models to do
Share of all OpenRouter tokens over 11 weekly captures, split by macro category
Each line is one workload. The y scale differs by panel; the current share is labelled at the right.
Agent workflow execution is still the largest single workload at 21.1%. General tasks are 33% of tokens; Data is 8%.
A flat line is a finding: most workloads moved by a few points over the record. The classification endpoint restates a trailing week, so the latest capture is the current view.
Source: OpenRouter (openrouter.ai/rankings), as of 2026-11-02. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.
